value.rationale: The singleton-fibre indicator of finite labelled maps is a canonical dependent occupancy profile. Proving exact binary Fourier invertibility for all orders and a fully explicit 2-adic eigenvalue stratification determines a natural full-spectrum arithmetic invariant, including a two-dimensional exceptional nullspace and all determinant exponents. This is substantially more informative than the known unsigned singleton-count generating functions; no unproved downstream application or Euclidean norm claim is needed.
